candidate_pool: Original7 + original11new +3same-source stable-log power controls=21groups,42mean/stdcoordinates. Numerical controls do not alter old features.
preprocessing: Per-patient original populationZ,then mean imputer fit subFIT only; trees need no global scaling. Patient-equal times inverse pooled subFIT class sample weights. EZ positive,validation threshold selector identical to earlier probes.
cv: 3shuffled patient GroupKFold inside each originalFIT,seed42+1009*outerfold; remaining patients split20percent calibration,seed+43*screen; no originalvalidation/Outer data in selection.
center_sensitivity: Each originalFIT center held out in turn. Other centers split patient-isolated20percent calibration,seed+700+53*center_index(one-based). Calibration never includes held-out-center patients. All4centers retained,no patient exclusions.
directional_stability: For each42coordinate,orientation is chosen by patient-mean raw-AUC inside subFIT only. Report oriented-AUC and fraction>0.5 on untouched screening patients and by their center. No held-out sign fitting,no claim that a feature is clinically useless from coefficients/correlation.
prune_rule: PeroriginalFIT:pairedpatientCVmean deletion-minus-FULL7 AUC>=-.002,AP>=-.002,MacroF1>=-.003; samebounds in>=2of3screens; center rule must pass. At most2groups,rank byMacroF1thenAPthenAUCthenloweroldindex.
add_rule: PeroriginalFIT:addition-minus-FULL7 mean AUC>=.005 orAP>=.005; bothAUC/AP>=-.002;MacroF1>=0;samegain/noninferiority in>=2of3screens;center rule must pass. At most3;rank bymin(AUCdelta,APdelta),MacroF1delta,AUC+APdelta,lowerindex.
center_rule: All4centers must have validpaired metrics. Median center-held-out deltas AUC>=-.002,AP>=-.002,MacroF1>=-.003; worstcenter AUC/AP>=-.01,MacroF1>=-.015. Registered before nonlinear results.
new_only_diagnostic: Also freeze top3 newfeatures under same addition ranking for a separately declared new-only comparison,even when formaladdition gates fail. This diagnostic is not a forced augmentation or an assertion of utility. Formalaugmentedmodel uses eligiblefeatures only;noeligible means noaddition.
feature_selection_freeze: Freeze independent per-outerFIT prune/add/new-only lists before any new M8 validation outcome is read. No globally selected best feature list. Exact later matchedM8 architecture/control protocol must be locked before its validation outcomes.
privacy: Private models,scalers,identities,predictions and logs remain server. Publicsource,anonymousaggregates and per-FIT feature names only. No new Outer access.
